title: The “Right” Discourse on Migration: Analysing Migration-Related Tweets in Right and Far-Right Political Movements

bias_targets.methodology: Topic modeling (BERTopic with Llama2 labeling) to identify xenophobic narratives and conspiracy theories, combined with a multilingual toxicity classifier to detect identity attacks, insults, and threats directed at migrants in right and far-right tweets.

Using a fine-tuned mBART-50 model to classify persuasion techniques (such as Ad Hominem, smears, and loaded language) predominantly used to attack opposing political figures, institutions, and ideologies.
Topic modeling keyword analysis identifying clusters that associate Muslim populations with terrorism, cultural replacement, and demographic threats (e.g., 'Great Replacement' conspiracy theory).
